values.title: About Me
values.subtitle: I am Mohammed Ameen Al-Wosabi, an Artificial Intelligence graduate passionate about building intelligent systems and applying AI to solve real-world problems.
values.card1Text: Engineered Basira Cashier AI, a vision-based smart retail checkout system powered by YOLOv8, FastAPI, and ESP32 hardware.
values.card2Text: Built Local-RAG-Workstation, an offline enterprise RAG platform using Next.js 15, FastAPI, LangGraph, Qdrant, and PostgreSQL with bilingual Arabic/English citations.
values.card3Text: Developed Itqan-Interview-AI, a multi-agent technical and behavioral interview simulator powered by LangGraph, STAR evaluation, and voice synthesis.
